{{Quote|Please, don't hurt me. I have nothing of value in here. Look for yourself and see!|The Ithorian|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
An '''Ithorian''' with light [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and light gray and yellow skin lived in the [[South Apartments]] of the [[Upper City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]],<ref name="KOTOR" /> in [[3956 BBY]].<ref>''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', which includes the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian's]] appearance, in [[3956 BBY]].</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Sometime after the [[Attack on the Endar Spire|attack on the]] ''[[Endar Spire]]'' in the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] above Taris, an amnesiac former [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] known as [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] was marooned on the planet. During his exploration of the area, Revan forced his way into the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian's]] apartment and scared them. The Ithorian begged Revan not to hurt them and claimed that they had nothing of value to steal.<ref name="KOTOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
This character appears in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games#Role-playing game|role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', released by [[LucasArts]] and developed by [[BioWare]]. The player can meet this character during the beginning of the game, after escaping the ''[[Endar Spire]]'', by picking or bashing the lock on theirapartment door. The Ithorian's apartment contains a bag with random loot in it and although they beg you not to harm them, the Ithorian can not be attacked. The game interface lists the character's name only as "Ithorian."<ref name="KOTOR" />
